scoring_justification: Checker recomputes zT from raw transport coefficient arrays inside thermoelectric_results.json and compares maximum zT values to paper-reported gold using threshold_or_better with monotonic scoring.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference max_zT bulk and barrier for each condition.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (explicit numbers) and approximated from Figures 2,4,7,10.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper statements (Bi2Te3 and Mg2SiSn) and estimated from Figure curves (Si0.8Ge0.2).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the reported or readable values from the published paper, verifiable by cross-checking the paper content.

schema.description: Top-level keys identify each condition (e.g., n_Bi2Te2.7Se0.3_500K_kappa_lat_0.5). Each value is an object with required fields: temperature_K (number), kappa_lat_W_mK (number), carrier_concentration_cm3 (array of numbers), sigma_bulk_S_m (array), S_bulk_microV_K (array), kappa_elec_bulk_W_mK (array), kappa_bi_bulk_W_mK (array), sigma_barrier_S_m (array), S_barrier_microV_K (array), kappa_elec_barrier_W_mK (array), kappa_bi_barrier_W_mK (array), zT_bulk (array), zT_barrier (array), max_zT_bulk (number), max_zT_barrier (number). All arrays are of equal length and correspond to the carrier concentrations.

outputs.description: Thermoelectric properties and zT vs. carrier concentration for the six material/type/temperature conditions under bulk and minority‑carrier blocking scenarios. The checker recomputes zT from the provided transport coefficients and compares max_zT values to hidden paper‑reported gold.

output_contract.notes: The checker will internally recompute zT = S²σT/(κ_elec + κ_lat) from each set of coefficients, verify self‑consistency with the stored zT arrays, then extract max_zT and compare the bulk and barrier maximums to gold. The score is monotonic: meeting or exceeding the paper‑reported zT earns full credit, and only worse results are penalized.
